description: Unsigned transactions that turn a line's credit into ETH in its agent's own wallet: make the agent's gas station if it has no code yet (anyone may; the station is the GasStationFactory's predict of the agent's wallet, never an address given), borrow amount USDG from the line to the station (the agent or the owner; the station must be on the allowlist), then pump(minOut, maxIn) by its full signature, with maxIn everything the station will hold and minOut a tenth of a percent under the pool's own fill for that size (never under the station's Chainlink floor). No amount: pump what the station already holds (anyone may). If ETH's price feed has been stale for 4 days, release() instead, sending the station's USDG to the agent's wallet as it is. Simulated from the wallet.

amount.description: USDG to borrow to the agent's gas station (optional; without it, pump what the station holds), in whole units as a decimal string, like "1.5"

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

name: credit_gas
title: Prepare: gas for an agent, from its line
